:root{--acid:#c7ff70;--red:#ff4a48;--glass:rgba(3,10,9,.76);--edge:rgba(177,231,158,.25)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#020605;color:#e8f4e7;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;touch-action:none}
#game{position:fixed;inset:0}canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
#grade{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 48%,transparent 16%,rgba(0,0,0,.32) 63%,rgba(0,0,0,.9) 100%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.2),transparent 35%,rgba(0,0,0,.35))}
#scan{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;opacity:.13;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 3px,#b7e6c3 4px,transparent 5px)}

.glass{background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px #0009;backdrop-filter:blur(7px)}
.brand{padding:9px 11px;max-width:68%}.brand b{display:block;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1.7px;color:var(--acid)}.brand span{display:block;color:#9eafa0;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.8px;margin-top:3px}
.readout{padding:8px 11px;min-width:100px;text-align:right}.readout small{display:block;color:#8b9c8e;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.3px}.readout strong{font-size:20px;color:var(--acid);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.mission{position:fixed;z-index:5;top:76px;left:9px;max-width:74%;padding:9px 11px}.eyebrow{font-size:9px;color:var(--red);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1.8px}.mission b{display:block;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.5px;margin:3px 0}.mission span{display:block;color:#bdcbbb;font-size:10px;line-height:1.35}
.modebar{position:fixed;z-index:6;right:9px;top:151px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}.mode,.action,.control{color:#edf6e9;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid var(--edge);border-radius:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.6px}.mode{padding:8px 9px;font-size:9px}.mode.active{background:var(--acid);color:#10190b;border-color:var(--acid)}
.bottom{position:fixed;z-index:6;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,5px) + 7px);left:9px;right:9px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;pointer-events:none}
.pad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:43px 43px 43px;grid-template-rows:40px 40px;gap:4px;pointer-events:auto}.control{font-size:17px;touch-action:none}.up{grid-column:2}.left{grid-column:1;grid-row:2}.down{grid-column:2;grid-row:2}.right{grid-column:3;grid-row:2}
.actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:112px;pointer-events:auto}.action{padding:10px 9px;font-size:10px}.hot{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#c7ff70,#699c3c);color:#10180b;border:0}.danger{border-color:#ff555577;color:#ffb7a8}
.hint{position:fixed;z-index:4;bottom:103px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:9px;color:#c8d7c6;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:0 2px 7px #000}
.crosshair{position:fixed;z-index:4;left:50%;top:50%;width:19px;height:19px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:.72;pointer-events:none}.crosshair:before,.crosshair:after{content:"";position:absolute;background:#d7ffb8;box-shadow:0 0 7px #aaff85}.crosshair:before{width:1px;height:19px;left:9px}.crosshair:after{height:1px;width:19px;top:9px}
